# Default key-value store

The API endpoints described in this section are convenience endpoints that provide access to Actor run's default key-value store without the need to resolve the key-value store ID first.

Subset of functionality described in: [Key-value stores](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/storage-key-value-stores.md)

<!-- -->

## [Get default store](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-get.md)

[/actor-runs/{runId}/key-value-store](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-get.md)

## [Update default store](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-put.md)

[/actor-runs/{runId}/key-value-store](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-put.md)

## [Delete default store](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-delete.md)

[/actor-runs/{runId}/key-value-store](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-delete.md)

## [Get default store's list of keys](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-keys-get.md)

[/actor-runs/{runId}/key-value-store/keys](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-keys-get.md)

## [Download default store's records](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-records-get.md)

[/actor-runs/{runId}/key-value-store/records](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-records-get.md)

## [Get default store's record](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-record-get.md)

[/actor-runs/{runId}/key-value-store/records/{recordKey}](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-record-get.md)

## [Store record in default store](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-record-put.md)

[/actor-runs/{runId}/key-value-store/records/{recordKey}](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-record-put.md)

## [Store record in default store (POST)](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-record-post.md)

[/actor-runs/{runId}/key-value-store/records/{recordKey}](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-record-post.md)

## [Delete default store's record](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-key-value-store-record-delete.md)
